The green fixed-price offers of ÉS (Électricité de Strasbourg) for the Gladys energy monitoring: Base,
Off-peak hours and the Week-end options, with or without the 100% regional option.

## What the integration does

It adds eight contract templates to the contract wizard of Gladys, and gives Gladys the French
national public holidays the Week-end options need. Gladys then prices your consumption by itself,
from the meter you already follow (Linky, TIC, current clamp…).

The integration connects to nothing: neither your ÉS customer area nor the Internet. There is no
login to type.

## The contracts

| Template in Gladys                                       | ÉS contract                                 | kWh prices             |
| -------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | ---------------------- |
| ÉS Green fixed price 1 year – Base                       | Offre verte à prix fixe 1 an                | Those of your contract |
| ÉS Green fixed price 1 year – Off-peak hours             | Offre verte à prix fixe 1 an                | Those of your contract |
| ÉS Green fixed price 1 year – Weekend                    | Offre verte, Week-end Base option           | Those of your contract |
| ÉS Green fixed price 1 year – Weekend + Off-peak hours   | Offre verte, Week-end et Heures Creuses     | Those of your contract |
| ÉS 100% regional green 1 year – Base                     | Offre électricité verte 100 % régionale     | Those of your contract |
| ÉS 100% regional green 1 year – Off-peak hours           | Offre électricité verte 100 % régionale     | Those of your contract |
| ÉS 100% regional green 1 year – Weekend                  | 100 % régionale, Week-end Base option       | Those of your contract |
| ÉS 100% regional green 1 year – Weekend + Off-peak hours | 100 % régionale, Week-end et Heures Creuses | Those of your contract |

The name of your contract and its option are on the front of your ÉS bill, under "option tarifaire".

**On the regulated Tarif Bleu?** It is not in this integration: pick the "Électricité de Strasbourg"
templates of the Gladys community catalogue, in the same wizard. They exist for each subscribed power,
with the price history.

The offers for businesses are not covered.

## Creating a contract

1. Open **Integrations → Energy Monitoring → Contracts** and create a contract for your meter.
2. Pick the "ÉS" template matching your bill.
3. Check the proposed values:
   - **Monthly subscription**: pre-filled for 6 kVA. The grid
     by subscribed power is shown under the field: type the amount of yours.
   - **Off-peak hours**: those of your meter, set by Strasbourg Électricité Réseaux (8 hours a day,
     often 10 pm to 6 am). They are on your bill.
   - **kWh prices**: these offers have a price fixed for one year from your
     signature. The fields are pre-filled with the current grid: replace them with the prices of your
     contract when they differ.
4. Choose the start date of the contract, look at the preview, save.

Every price includes taxes.

At the yearly renewal, ÉS sends you new prices: create a new contract in Gladys from that date, with
those prices.

## The Week-end options and the public holidays

With the Week-end options, the reduced price applies from Saturday 0:00 to Sunday midnight and on
national public holidays. Good Friday and 26 December, holidays in Alsace only, are billed by ÉS as
weekdays: so does the integration.

The integration publishes these holidays to the `holidays-fr` calendar of Gladys. When another
integration already provides this calendar, it keeps it and the ÉS templates read its values. Check
then that it does not count the Alsace-Moselle holidays.

## Price sources

- Green offers: ÉS grids of 1 November 2026 (INF-1186 and INF-1192).

The grids in force are published on [particuliers.es.fr](https://particuliers.es.fr/electricite-gaz/electricite/choisir-la-bonne-offre-delectricite).

## How to install Électricité de Strasbourg in Gladys

1. In Gladys, open **Integrations**: Électricité de Strasbourg appears in the catalog, next to the native integrations, with a community badge.
2. Click **Install**. Gladys pulls the Docker image (`ghcr.io/smuteau/gladys-electricite-de-strasbourg:0.2.0`), starts it in a sandbox isolated from the core, and generates the integration's interface (devices, discovery and configuration).
3. Open the **Configuration** screen of the integration, fill in the settings, and save.
4. You can also install it directly from its repository URL: [https://github.com/smuteau/gladys-electricite-de-strasbourg](https://github.com/smuteau/gladys-electricite-de-strasbourg).

Électricité de Strasbourg requires Gladys `>=5.3.0`. The catalog inside Gladys refreshes every hour, so a new version becomes available at most one hour after its release.

Not running Gladys yet? It is free and open source: [follow the installation guide](/docs/) to get started.

## About external integrations

Électricité de Strasbourg is an **external integration**: a community integration packaged as a Docker container and published on GitHub, that Gladys installs in one click and runs in a sandbox isolated from its core. It is published and maintained by [smuteau](https://github.com/smuteau), not by the Gladys core team.
